answer: Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a nadir index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Because the reef index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the ridge audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 135 aliases as a result needs 135 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup.
